title: Cyber-Physical System for Environmental Monitoring Based on Deep Learning.
summary: A deep-learning classifier assigned environmental-monitoring sensor signals to the study’s defined classes and was evaluated on the reported dataset. The result is limited to that sensing setup and dataset; it does not establish performance in other deployments.
ai_technology: A deep neural network classified signals from the environmental-monitoring system.
